about_the_game:
Are politicians truly idealists?

In Electoral Empire, you are a newly elected president standing at the peak of power.

Ideals? Those are for speeches -- meant for the people to hear.

In real politics, you pursue your goals by any means necessary.

Manipulate the media, spread rumors, buy congressmen, control the markets --

All for one purpose: reelection.

And when you finally win it all, you’ll realize:

Power was never truly "elected".

Does the game support a specific political ideology?

No. Electoral Empire doesn’t promote any political side. Instead, it satirizes how unchecked power can corrupt any ideology, whether left or right. The game is about manipulation, not morality. It’s up to players to decide whether to uphold democracy… or dismantle it piece by piece.

And yes — our Demo is out. But to be honest, it’s not perfect; we’re just a team of 1.5 people. So please add our game to your wishlist so you won’t miss any updates.

🏛️ Democracy is a Means. Empire is the End.

Electoral Empire: Vote to Rule, Lie to Shine is a strategy game that fuses political simulation, negotiation-based card gameplay, population modeling, and a heavy dose of dark satire.

You’re not here to govern the nation — you’re here to use it.
Climb your way to the throne, one manipulated system at a time, and turn democracy itself into the very tool that crowns you emperor.

You are a democratically elected president, but your goal isn’t to serve the people — it’s to serve yourself. Control the legislature, dominate the media, start wars, crash the crypto markets, rig the stock exchange, build your secret treasury, bribe judges, command the military, rewrite the constitution — and yes, turn the entire country into your personal inheritance.

You don’t need to understand. You just need endless wins.

🎮 Gameplay Features

🃏 Negotiation Card Battles — You Choose the Goal
The objective isn’t to defeat your opponent — it’s to sway them.
Use cards to manipulate the “willpower” of politicians, generals, and justices across multiple negotiation rounds. Every card is a political weapon. Every encounter is psychological warfare by design.

👥 Population Simulation by Demographic Group
The U.S. population is broken down into dynamic groups of 10,000 to simulate — wealthy elites, blue-collar workers, tech immigrants, hardline religious blocs, unionists, nationalists…
Every policy, every coup, every event sparks ripple effects across groups. Your political achievement may be their collective downfall.

📉 Financial System: Legal Money Won’t Cut It, Illegal Money Will
Legit budgets are too clean for real power.
Manipulate the stock market, inflate and deflate crypto, and build your “off-the-books” treasury. That secret vault funds the real politics: bribes, black ops, narrative control. What the public doesn’t see will help you reign.

⚖️ Judicial system: Let the Courts Choke on Public Outrage
Can’t bribe the judiciary? No problem — drown it.
Trigger media frenzies, unleash fake polls, seed explosive scandals, and watch the courts collapse under “trial by public opinion.”
You don’t need to win in court — you just need to keep the judges busy enough to miss your constitutional rewrite.

📢 Truth comes from repetition

Brainwashing never requires technical content.

Just repeat a sentence 10 million times and it will become "common sense".

Of course you know that cutting education funding will make people stupider and the country worse.

But do you really care? The stupider, the easier it is for you to rule, right?

In "Electoral Empire", you can:

Cut public education and shape obedient citizens;

Precisely deliver "patriotic teaching materials" to let students actively defend you;

Give special funding to schools that are willing to broadcast your "golden words" every day, making brainwashing a glorious task.

Control public opinion, write curriculum, and modify the truth -

This is not a historical regression, this is a shortcut to the throne. 

The United States is of course a country with freedom of speech, and you can allow people to praise you freely. As for those who criticize you, they are your enemies, and enemies naturally have no freedom of speech.

🪖 The Military Doesn’t Serve the Nation. It Serves You.
Election day is near. You still don’t control Congress. The Supreme Court resists.
Doesn’t matter. You already control the one institution that settles all debates: the military.

By funding weapons industries, shifting defense budgets, and promoting loyal officers through “anti-terror drills,” you’ve quietly turned the national army into your private force.
Deploy them under the banner of “securing electoral integrity” — blockade parliament, seize courts, freeze the vote.
Not a coup. Just a “routine operation.”

Once the barrel of a gun joins the negotiating table, the real game begins.

💥 You’re Not Governing a Country. You’re Consuming It.
This isn’t a game about how to be a good president.
This is a game about turning the state into your side hustle.
Democracy is the decor. The constitution is a tool. The people are tokens. Power is the only real currency.

🗳️ From Elected President to Forever Emperor — The Full Arc of Power
Winning the election is just the prologue.
Through legal loopholes, staged crises, financial maneuvers, and a steady erosion of institutions, you’ll eliminate term limits, silence dissent, dissolve elections, install military rule — and ascend the throne.
And yes, the game continues after that.

🧠 Core Concepts (Do you really need to understand?)

  • Democracy? Just fancy wrapping paper for your crown.

  • Negotiation? Belief system, written in cash.

  • Governing? Why not use the government… to play the markets?

Electoral Empire: All Lies Trump Truth
A satire where “government by the people” becomes “godhood by design.”
You don’t need to understand — you just need to win.
